features.description: Decode, validate, deadband, re-encode, and fan out Sparkplug B through Expanso Edge
Inspect real input, output, and shipped YAML for six stages
Show source, Cloud control, Edge processing, and HiveMQ data flow
Verify primary, archive, metrics, quarantine, TLS, and authentication outcomes
Preserve the OPC UA to Sparkplug behavior removed with Ignition in commits 919390c and 5477d01 through the direct publisher

browser_assertions.description: Left and Right page stages without moving the scroll anchor
Light loads by default and the explicit toggle enables dark mode
No horizontal overflow at 320, 400, 768, or 1440 pixels
